arithmetic.latchCostFrom: beaconCost(i) = ceil(Balance.beacon.costBase 25 * 1.3^i / 5) * 5 -> [25,35,45,55,75,95], six sites, six beacons
arithmetic.panYieldFrom: 2 live seams x Balance.goldSeam.capacity 30; activeMin 2 of 4 anchors; respawn 20 s at a DIFFERENT anchor (HarvestSystem.pickOpenAnchor), two clusters 56 wu apart
arithmetic.headroomFrom: one Balance.goldSeam.capacity, so the last sweep before the descent is never refused mid-pan (Economy.canReceiveIncome would drop a whole 5 g tick and log gold_capped)

incomeCeiling.source: viewlog-ceiling.json (uncapped control at bankCap 900: viewlog-onedescent-900.json agrees row for row up to the plateau)
incomeCeiling.sustainedRate: 800 g over 600 s = 1.33 g/s; 240 g over the first 180 s = 1.33 g/s
incomeCeiling.priorArt: heat 12 generation 60 measured 180 g at t = 180 (1.00 g/s); the blocker's theoretical ceiling is 2.07 g/s
incomeCeiling.openingCommute: 81.4 wu from the stake (0,-44) to the nearest anchor (-34,30) at Balance.agent.moveSpeed 4.8 = 17.0 s, measured at 17.3 s
incomeCeiling.pylonTour: 143.4 wu over the six sites in route order = 29.9 s at 4.8 wu/s
incomeCeiling.conclusion: 330 g of cumulative income lands at t ~ 225 even uncapped, and the tour needs ~30 s after that, so the latch cannot close before t ~ 255 against a t = 210 deadline. At the blocker's own optimistic 2.07 g/s the floor is 159.4 s of panning + 17.0 s commute + 29.9 s tour = 206.3 s, which clears t = 180 by 26 s and only just fits t = 210 with 3.7 s to spare. The purse was necessary and is not sufficient.
